# Regional Notes Formatter

Formats a user's travel notes, preserving regional flag emoji such as
🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 and 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿, alongside place names written in the
original script, e.g. 日本語 (Japanese), 한국어 (Korean), and
中文 (Chinese). Purely a text transformation — no file or network access.
